subject: Follow-up: rotating deep-dive slots for PacificHealth

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: rotating deep-dive slots for PacificHealth

Hi Liam — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in a technical deep-dive (30–45m) with our solutions engineer.

Recap (2 min):
- Goal: validate latency/cost profile for your multi-region inference use case (patient-data summarization + on-prem gateway).
- Primary success criteria: <5% regression vs. baseline in throughput, encryption-at-rest confirmed, and deployment cadence for pilot.

Scheduling ask: you mentioned team members across US, EU, and APAC need to attend rotating windows so no single group is forced to always join late/early. To be fair we propose a 3-week rotation pattern: each week the deep-dive occurs at one of three timebands so ownership rotates across regions.

Proposed initial rotation (week 1–3, repeat):
- Week A (US-friendly): Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / Wed 02:00 SGT
- Week B (EU-friendly): Wed 15:00 CET / 09:00 ET / Thu 00:00 AEST
- Week C (APAC-friendly): Thu 09:00 SGT / Wed 16:00 CET / Wed 10:00 PT

Options: we can run the first 3 sessions in the next two weeks to surface any friction and then pick a standing rota. If you prefer a single pilot slot (no rotation) for the first month, tell us which timeband works best.

Attachments: I've attached a mutual action plan (stub) that maps stakeholders and deliverables. Also added a scheduling sheet link below so your team can mark availability.

Next steps (please):
1) Reply with preferred path: a) start 3-week rotation; b) single pilot slot for 1 month; or c) propose alternative cadence.
2) Identify one technical attendee (name + email) for the deep-dive.
3) If procurement needs to be looped for terms, cc procurement@pacifichealth.com and we'll share a summary.

Scheduling sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBzExampleSched
Attachment: PacificHealth_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx

Thanks — happy to adapt.

—
Naomi Feldman

- Procurement: copying procurement@pacifichealth.com to keep them in the loop — they might ask for a short statement of work once we confirm scope.
